description: Static fail-closed notice selected when BioETL Ops HTTP is not provisioned.

panels.description: No Ops HTTP query is executed in the Prometheus-only dashboard profile.

options.content:
Ops HTTP not provisioned

Grafana is running in Prometheus-only mode. This dashboard is intentionally replaced by a static notice because selected-run evidence requires a validated BioETL Ops HTTP datasource.

No retention, replay, identity, or run verdict can be inferred from this notice. Check /var/lib/grafana/bioetl-bootstrap-status.json; the full dashboard is restored only when ops_http=ready, reason=identity_matched, and dashboard_profile=full.

Recover with python scripts/ops/runtime/docker/runtime_manager.py start --stack monitoring --timeout 180, then verify status --stack monitoring.
